semantic_fragments.content: Clause 15.4.1 addresses incorrect connection of accessible connectors removable without a TOOL: (a) patient lead plugs must not connect to outlets intended for other functions unless no unacceptable RISK results; (b) medical gas connections for different gases must not be interchangeable. Both sub-clauses are N/A for this equipment as there are no patient leads and no medical gas connections.

Clause 15.4.2.1 comprehensively covers thermal cut-outs and over-current releases for ME EQUIPMENT. All sub-clauses (a through h) are rated N/A for this device as it contains no thermal cut-outs, over-current releases, thermostats, fluid-filled containers, or tubular heating elements. This indicates the device does not employ active heating or thermal protection mechanisms.
